description.value: Beginning at 10th level, the medic's knowledge of medical injections improves. Adrenaline Shot also grants an additional attack with a -2 penalty on all attack rolls. Feline Vision also gains Darkvision (60 feet) and now grants a +8 competence bonus to Perception checks. Mental Boost now grants a +4 alchemical bonus to Int/Wis/Cha. Physical Boost now grants a +4 alchemical bonus to Str/Dex/Con. Regenerative Serum now grants Fast Healing 4.
